concept.title: How the parts fit together
concept.shortdesc: The work is divided into separate components, each doing one job and passing a defined output to the next.

conbody.p: Each component is kept in its own repository. Components exchange files in agreed, versioned formats and share no program code, so any one of them can be replaced or reused on its own.

fig.title: The components and what passes between them

image.alt: Directories feed a gather-and-clean component. Its output goes to a component that builds the classification occasionally and to a component that labels every listing nightly. The classification and the labels go to a search component, which serves AI assistants, professionals and the public.
